mentions.name: LunaKron
mentions.description: This GPS-enabled moon-phase clock is hand-made and syncs via a tiny GPS module wired to an Arduino, parsed with the TinyGPSPlus library; besides a natural wood aesthetic version, other versions feature futuristic black acrylic with a photorealistic silvery moon.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm really glad you like the LunaKron. I make a couple other versions that have less wood aesthetic and more futuristic black acrylic with a photorealistic, silvery moon.

I connect a tiny GPS module to the Arduino via 3 wires: power, ground, and serial input, and use Mikal Hart's "TinyGPSPlus" module to parse the NMEA data streams.
